Research & Projects

Optimization, machine learning, and simulation for operational decisions.

Selected work

Current doctoral research, earlier collaborative studies, and selected applied projects. Each page identifies the context, methods, and evidence supporting the findings.

Doctoral research · Clemson · Ongoing

Healthcare Workforce Planning and Scheduling

Preference-based and fatigue-aware optimization informed by clinician interviews, surveys, and operational requirements. Synthetic scheduling benchmarks met an average of 84–87% of weighted preference categories while satisfying all hard staffing rules.

Research program →
Graduate research · UT Space Institute · Published 2024

Learning-Based Optimization for the Traveling Salesman Problem

A coauthored learning-based routing study. Published benchmarks showed a 28% smaller average optimality gap and 59% less computation time than a graph pointer network on 1,000-node instances.

Details →
Graduate research · UT Space Institute · Published 2022

Agent-Based Simulation of the Bullwhip Effect

An agent-based study of information sharing and risk pooling. Their combined use reduced simulated order-to-demand variance by 46.3% at the factory and 49.3% at the wholesaler.

Details →
Course project · Clemson · Spring 2025

Predicting Emergency Department Admissions

Compared admission-prediction models using structured triage data and chief-complaint text. CatBoost achieved ROC-AUC 0.863, compared with 0.853 for logistic regression.

Details →
Graduate course project · Clemson

Dynamic Physician Allocation with Markov Decision Processes

Formulated dynamic physician allocation as a Markov decision process and compared four solution methods on synthetic instances. Policy iteration was the fastest method in the reported experiments.

Details →
Industry collaboration · Team project

Diagnosing Production Downtime at Fresenius Medical Care

The team identified a failure mode accounting for 36% of recorded downtime and proposed standardized failure reporting and operating procedures.
